content:
In celebration of the ongoing $50 discount on AirPods Pro 3, today's 9to5Toys mid-day flash sale features highlights including the titanium case 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 at $184 off, aluminum Cell models at $130 off, and more deals starting from $299. Rare deals on the Apple Keyboard and black Magic Mouse are surprisingly still available, and we also have a solid discount on my favorite Anker Prime Power Bank (which doubles as a wall charger), but today's real accessory focus is the Nomad anniversary sitewide sale, offering rare deals on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, Find My cards, Apple Watch bands, and more. Read on for details.

Pick up the all-new AirPods Pro 3 for nearly $50 off this summer, with more deals starting from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 — $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 — $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation — $149 (originally $179)

Back in stock: Amazon takes $184 off the slate gray titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 starting today

This deal sold out in a flash yesterday, so those interested shouldn't hesitate today. The slate gray titanium 46mm GPS+Cell Apple Watch Series 11 is once again $184 off at Amazon.

Amazon is now shipping the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS+Cell model with a slate gray titanium case and black sport band for $564.97 with free shipping.

This is the high-end titanium case model, priced at $749. With today's likely fleeting deal, you can save $184, making it one of the best prices we've tracked for this model. Although it briefly dropped to $550 last month ahead of Prime Day, aside from that, this is the lowest price we've tracked for this configuration.

Again, this deal is only for those who are set on titanium and the slate gray colorway, as even with the discount, the price remains steep. However, the more popular aluminum models in the Series 11 lineup are also seeing $100 and $130 discounts this week:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 — $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 — $329 (originally $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS+Cell — from $399 (originally $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS+Cell — from $399 (originally $529)

Rare Apple Keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals (surprisingly) still live, historic lows from $80

We certainly see plenty of deals on mainstream Apple products — $50 off AirPods Pro 3, up to $130 off the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models — but deals on Magic accessories are rarer. However, we are surprisingly still seeing Prime Day pricing continue on the basic Magic Keyboard, the full-size model with Touch ID, and the black Apple Magic Mouse.

Before these extended Prime Day discounts, deals on these Apple accessories have always been extremely rare, and there's no way to predict how long these offers will last.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse — $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard — $80 (originally $99)
  • Full-size Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID — $145 (originally $179)

All three products are at the lowest prices we've tracked on Amazon to date. It's been a long time since we've seen the black Apple Magic Mouse go for such a low price (I'm personally looking to grab a backup one myself), and both Magic Keyboard models are at historic lows — the basic version has only hit this price point once before, while the Touch ID version has never dropped below $158.

If you're looking to upgrade your Apple Magic input devices, with these extended Prime Day deals still in effect, now might be the best time to do it.

Nomad anniversary sitewide sale now live: rare deals on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, Apple Watch bands, and more

Rare 20% off: Nomad metal/glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stand

There are certainly cheaper 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands on the market, but almost none are as premium and stylish as Nomad's latest model. They aren't cheap, but thanks to the brand's 2026 anniversary sale, we're now tracking rare discounts on both the 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models to cover your entire Apple on-the-go setup.

Nomad's 2026 anniversary sale is now live, with plenty of discounts on iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging accessories, while the deals on the Stand One and Stand One Max are among the rarest of the bunch:

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One — $103 (originally $129)
  • Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max — $135 (originally $169)

What you're looking at here is Nomad's latest generation 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stand. They're now 20% off, which might not sound like much, but they almost never go on sale.

We're talking about a metal unibody construction with a substantial weight, paired with a glass finish, providing an elegant and luxurious home for your Apple devices.

The only downside to this deal is that the newly released cosmic orange colorway is not included in the discount:

Rare discount: Nomad Tracking Card — Apple Find My Pro model, cosmic orange, Google Find Hub, and more

Nomad's anniversary sale is now live, and although there were some hiccups with the earlier Tracking Card Pro and Air deals earlier, they are now officially available. The discounts aren't huge, but they are rare, with the Apple Find My and Google Find Hub versions starting from $32.

The Nomad Tracking Card easily ranks as one of the best in the industry, featuring wireless MagSafe charging capability — it's a must-have for me when I'm out and about:

  • Tracking Card Air — $32 (originally $35) — Apple Find My or Google Find Hub
  • Tracking Card Pro — $41 (originally $45) — all three colors available

Nomad titanium Stratos Apple Watch band 20% off for the anniversary (rare deal)

My favorite display-equipped Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger drops to $70 this summer

Anker's 2026 summer sale continues, with plenty of discounts on the latest Prime charging devices, power banks, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe charging stands, and more. One of my personal favorites among the brand's portable charging solutions has also dropped back to its 2026 low of $69.99 — the 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank, which also doubles as a wall charger.

The 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank is now available on Amazon for $69.99 with free shipping. Originally priced as high as $90, we've tracked this deal several times this year, but I'm hoping no one misses it this week because it has become the most practical portable charging device in my everyday carry over the past year.

Among the brand's latest generation of power banks, there are certainly models with larger capacities and faster charging output, but this one is extremely practical for me. It's one of the more compact options in the brand's lineup, easily fitting into my everyday carry, while also featuring a built-in smart display, USB-C port, and enough capacity to handle my charging needs for a day out or longer.

Check out my hands-on review right now.

It's also one of the few models in the series that doubles as a wall charger. There are foldable prongs on the back of the power bank, allowing you to charge the internal battery while using it as a wall charger — I absolutely love this design, as it means I don't need to carry an extra device to top it up.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • This 140W four-port charger can power your entire setup from a single wall outlet, just $35 today (41% off)
  • Power up your iPhone and AirPods: this dual Qi charging desk pad is now $30 (originally $70)
  • The 250W Anker Prime charging station with LCD display can replace six chargers, now from $95
  • Belkin 100W USB-C GaN wall charger just dropped to an all-time low on Amazon of $25.50
  • Satechi's latest display-equipped ChargeView 140W desktop charger drops back to its Prime Day low of $80
  • Add four Matter-certified Edison bulbs to your Apple, Google, or Alexa smart home for under $8 each
  • Add premium Matter-enabled ambiance to your home: Govee 3-pack permanent outdoor lights Prism from $430
  • Grab this DOCKCASE 2-in-1 USB-C SD card reader for just $7 (47% off) and toss it in your tech organizer
  • Rare deal: Belkin 25W UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 MagSafe charging stand drops to an all-time low on Amazon
  • Still live: Anker's latest 45W Nano charger with smart display, just $26 today (all colors available)
  • UGREEN FineTrack Slim Find My wallet tracker with MagSafe charging, just $18 today
  • Snap this magnetic Apple Watch band onto your wrist for $20 (save 41%)
  • Anker 10-port flat-plug power strip now down to $20 at Amazon

Still live: Anker 3-port 160W smart display charger drops back to Prime Day price (33% off), more deals from $8

In addition to ongoing discounts on Anker's smart display Qi2 25W charger and the latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging station, we've also tracked its display-equipped 160W 3-port Prime charger dropping back to its Prime Day price (33% off).

Amazon's official Anker store is now shipping the smart display 3-port Prime charger for $99.99 with free shipping.

For a product that's essentially a wall charger, the price isn't cheap, but we're talking about one with a built-in smart display, capable of outputting up to 160W of power, and with a form factor "as compact as an AirPods Pro 3 case, easy to carry, yet with enough power to handle your devices."

More precisely, it can output up to 140W from a single USB-C port, capable of charging a "16-inch MacBook Pro from 0% to 50% in 25 minutes."

As for the smart display, it uses AnkerSense View technology, allowing you to "monitor real-time battery levels on the screen, instantly switch modes, and unlock custom modes via the app over Bluetooth."
